** Pazar ve resmi tatil günleri yapılmaz.

Read as rounds: each row leaves Kadıköy, calls at the next printed piers in column order, and its last printed departure sails back to Kadıköy; rows whose gaps don't fit one vessel are separate trips. Arrival times aren't printed and are computed from the route.
